# PetroFI

> PetroFI is petrol pump management software for India. Every rupee is tracked. Sales, credit customers, expenses, inventory, tanks, cash and bank. Get the reports you need. Petrol pump software free download on iOS and Android. Trusted by 500+ pump owners.

PetroFI is a petrol pump management system for owners and managers. It tracks fuel sales (nozzle and shift), credit customers (udhar), expenses and other transactions, lubricants and non-fuel inventory, tank stock, cash in hand, and bank accounts. Reports include inventory sales, customer credit, tank, cash & bank book, and combined reports.
